notes.title: 1.052 update - Bug Fixes and Balance
notes.notes:
Bugs fixed:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the “Sales” passive in the survival branch could spawn an item with a smaller pop up
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the “be as water” passive from the soldier path to prevent the character from dashing
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the “Tesla” passive from the scientist path to activate infinitely on a dead enemy
[*] Fixed a bug that could make chasing enemies stuck against walls
[*] Fixed a bug that could prevent progression in the tutorial if the player restarted the game while in bibots.
[*] Fixed a bug that could make scarab enemies die prematurely in a fight
[*] Fixed a bug that made the shuriken from the tactical ability “Surprise shuriken” remain after death
[*] Fixed a bug that made the first slides of the prologue not being displayed after a restart
[*] Fixed a bug that made the “Born flayer” passive from the soldier path give bibot’s attacks the bleed property
[*] Fixed a bug that made the visual effect from the passive “Plague” from the soldier path appear on enemies that were not affected
[*] Fixed a bug that made enemies teleported by the “Mass grave” passive from the soldier path to die at the same time as the enemy that triggered the effect
[*] Fixed a bug that made slime enemies teleported by the “Mass grave” passive from the soldier path to appear at the wrong location
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the time of the battle against the last boss and the completion time of the last biome to be displayed in the details of the end game recap.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the player to navigate between their unlocked passives in the character menu with a controller
[*] Fixed a bug the locked the progression in the tutorial if the player picked a psym cannister too soon
[*] Fixed a bug that made the slime enemies stuck in place after a dodge from the player
[*] Removed an unwanted collision in a chest room in biome 2: No’okmul
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the player from picking up items after opening the sarcophages in biome 1 : Makbara without picking up the spawned items.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the corrupted teleporting enemy from walking before its teleportation.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented to move the map with a keyboard he first time it was opened 
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the Neutrinox rifle’s projectiles to go through enemies
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause the player’s homing projectiles to track their own decoy
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the bullet trail chip to spawn too many bullets
[/list]

Balance:

[list]
[*] Made enemies invincible for an instant after being charmed, preventing them from dying inadvertently without being able to be of use to the player.
[*] Reduced the screenshake when shooting with the sniper rifle: NT-Maser
[*] The experience gauge is no longer displayed in the end game menu once the selected bibot is level 20
[*] Reduced the probability the get a common or legendary equipment from the timed confrontation challenge in the biome 2 No’okmul
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix patch
notes.notes:
Hotfix patch is out:

Fixed a bug where the time played in previous playthroughs for every biome was kept in the timestamps calculation, making the time doors unable to be opened after subsequent playthroughs.

notes.title: Third update is here!
notes.notes:
Hello,

Here is the third patch note of Bibots!
We focused on fixing bugs that were mainly reported on our discord, we thank you again for the feedback you give us there!

We also brought new interface elements for clarity and to give more informations to the player, especially to be able to compare the basic damage of weapons without having to pick them up.

We are actively working on the integration of achievements as it is a feature that has been requested a lot, it will be available very soon.

[h1]PATCH NOTE :[/h1]

[b]User Interface:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added an element in the UI that displays the base damage of the equipped weapon
[*] Added an element in the weapon pop ups interface that indicates the base damage of the weapon the player is interacting with
[*] Added an element in the character selection menu interface to make it clearer which composup is currently hovered by the player
[/list]

[b]Passives :[/b]

[list]
[*] Balanced the bonus given by the passive "The Digger" on energy packs
[/list]

[b]Others:[/b]

[list]
[*] Made a change on the time of the speedrun doors. Now the doors require a time that is specific to the current biome rather than a cumulative time to be opened.
[/list]

[b]Bugs :[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed the player to upgrade the weapon beyond the 5 chip slots limit
[*] Fixed a collision issue that allowed the player to exit the "Maghamir" boss room
[*] Fixed a bug on the tactical ability "Lockpick". Now when the player will use this ability to open the door with 3 locks in the second biome, the uses of the ability will be spent correctly
[*] Fixed a bug on the "Business is business" passive that could cause a difference between the real price of an item and the one displayed in the interface
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the "Ultimate Pride" passive from working properly
[/list]

notes.title: Meet the Team
notes.notes:
Hello everyone ! 

It's been a few days since we launched Bibots. 

But we never introduced the devs behind this game.

Bibots is developed by 3 people. 

Younes: He is in charge of the graphic aspect of Bibots. From the concept to the animation of the characters and monsters, including the creation of the sceneries. 

Philippe: With Benjamin he takes care of the game design and code. He also manages the Level Design and Technical Art with Younes.

Benjamin: In addition to the game design and code, he is in charge of the AI of the enemies and the bosses. He also produces the game's FX.

Bibots is our first achievement and we are working hard to keep on improving your gaming experience.

The Bibots team.

notes.title: Bibots' first patch
notes.notes:
Hello,

Here is Bibots' first patch!

We've considered all player's feedback. As for all Rogue Like, the diversity of experiences and point of view makes the balancing of the game tricky. 
We've seen players accustomed to this kind of game playing with ease, but also other players whose experience has been more difficult.

To answer every feedback in the best way possible we decided to integrate these fixes!

Patch note:

[b][u]Economy:[/u][/b]

[list]
[*] Recycling value is balanced. It's now a fixed value of 50 Crebuks per recycled item.
[*] Enemies now drop Crebuks more frequently
[/list]

[b][u]Monsters:[/u][/b]

[list]
[*] Biome 1 boss - Nazir's health is reduced
[*] Nazir's attack speed is reduced when his clone appears
[*] Nazir's clone pattern is simplified
[*] Difficulty curve between Biome has been balanced. Monsters have more life when progressing between Biomes
[*] Biome 2/3/4 bosses's health have been increased
[*] The possibility to see boosted enemies after Biome 2 is now bigger
[/list]

[b][u]Bibots:[/u][/b]

[list]
[*] Psym is now gained more easily
[*] You now can stay longer in Bibots form
[*] Doli / Kranzer / Nitric's damage has been reduced
[/list]

[u][b]Passives:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Passive “Lucky Day” and “Survival Instinct” have less chance to drop hearts
[*] Passive “Chemist” has been deleted since players are now invulnerable to area of effect
[*] Passive “Mass Grave” has been deactivated until bugs related to it are fixed
[/list]

[u][b]Chips:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] "Piñata" chips' synergy with Bleeding has been decreased
[*] "Molotov" doesn't inflict damage to players anymore
[*] "Flame trail" doesn't inflict damage to players anymore
[/list]

[u][b]Tactical Abilities:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] The number of use of "Gravitating Orbs" has been decreased
[*] Tactical Abilities "Molotov" doesn't inflict damage to players anymore
[/list]

[u][b]Weapons:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Peashooter's damage has been decreased
[*] Peashooter's fire rate has been decreased
[*] Sniper Maxthuzalem has seen its damage and fire rate increased
[*] Sniper Calisto M00N 2 has seen its damage increased
[*] Shotgun TITAN M00N 2's damage has been increased
[*] Pistol R.O.G.U.E's damage has been increased
[*] Sniper KHEOPS's damage has been increased
[*] Assault Rifle TRAJAN's damage has been decreased
[/list]

[u][b]Pick Ups:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Lootable objects are not pushed by the player anymore
[/list]

[u][b]Other:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Shield price has been increased
[/list]

[u][b]Bugs:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Fixed the bug that prevented the recycling possibility to be displayed correctly when interacting with an object
[/list]
[list]
[*] Fixed the bug that give player experience after defeating the final boss that cause UI conflict
[/list]
[list]
[*] Fixed the bug that made FX related to the "kombo slice" chip remain between playthroughs
[/list]

Future changes:

This is just the first patch. We intend to release other ones soon, including a revamped balancing of the weapons, and other bug fixes. 

Thank you for your feedbacks.

notes.title: Weapons personnalization last look
notes.notes:
Bibots is already launching next week! What do you say we talk about weapon personalization today?

Pick your weapon or loot some and add chips in it! The number of weapon's available modding slots depend on their rarity when you drop them:

- Basic weapons: 1 slot
- Rare weapons : 2 slots
- Epic weapons : 2 slots
- Legendary weapons : 3 slots

At its maximum a weapon can only have 5 slots, like this one:

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/c82f41be3beb01f49a9554be377862400a661a05.gif[/img]

This weapon has every slots unlocked but that will not be the case for weapons you'll loot! All weapons can be upgraded in specific rooms if you have the money. But beware, those upgrades only have a percentage of success. Use some "nanites" to get higher chance of success.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/d69b00b5649bc3e6c6ee1c229f584ab24a594f7f.gif[/img]

And that's what a modded weapon looks like! We might have gone overboard with this one...

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/908396bf977ad0a5016c55ae941099d2fa9ad0b6.gif[/img]

notes.title: Bibots and their customisation
notes.notes:
With the demo out since Gamescom we hope you're enjoying yourselves! If you've missed the information Bibots is coming out October 5th.

In the meantime allow us to introduce the 5 different Bibots you'll be able to use at your advantage.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/d35b0b559273e8b44917e78fede134f61b5dfc4e.gif[/img]

Doli - As he was departing for combat Tamal entrusted Doli, an old generation Bibot, to Tayar. A handy and very agressive Bibot.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/03c651cd62f8e957e33fc64384cddcaa732611a0.gif[/img]

Kranzer - Kranzer belongs to the oldest generation of Bibot and participated to numerous exploration expedition. But do not trust its simple design and slower moves, its important firepower allows Kranzer to quickly get rid of any group of enemy.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/61dc5253c7456092f9cf10428d524b21cc8f1c72.gif[/img]

Nitric - Nitric is part of a recent generation of Bibot, coupled to the psymic memory of old Crob soldiers. Its poisoned projectiles allows this Bibot to deal a huge amount of damages even to the most robust foes.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/eb8a4129c728a66ddc8826a0768e3ef01130750f.gif[/img]

Octron - Octron also comes from a recent generation of Bibot. Technologies' breakthrough and a better psym mastery allows its engineer to provide it with a way to electrocute its foes and produce huge amount of area damages. 

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/9bc0c6480385634c7e05c93cca79a47686957f35.gif[/img]

Kamak - Kamak is the fruit of the latest discovery in Crob technoloogy and psym mastery. It is the only Bibot capable of using inflammed and freezing projectiles allowing hom to face everything coming its way. 

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/d154ada95c43cc573d9c7cbff6f7df870ad7e2bb.gif[/img]

Complete run by reaching the end (or dying) and gain some Bibots' experience and nanites. 

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/e77d3adc322fa0d00f11e9088b0cf5db0580e1a8.gif[/img]

Leveling up your Bibots will unlock some power up called Compos'up and each Bibot has 10 Compos'up to unlock throughout 20 levels! And that's where nanites, one of Bibots' currency, are useful as they allow you to buy these Compos'up. The latter allows you to personalize your Bibot's weapons, main and secondary. But choices must be made as only 1 out 5 Compos'up can be used for each weapon until some times... 

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/84f77e1b46c5063e6ff497ef605341640268c0cf.gif[/img]

notes.title: Level up - Survivalist's path
notes.notes:
Take the advice from the survival expert Bearbots Grylls. Improvise. Adapt. Level up. Today we'll focus on the Survivalist's path that Tayar can follow.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/6905e269e4dabbbca843c2e4cecb986f8ec993d2.gif[/img]

If you let Tayar follow the Survivalist's path, he will get one more heart to survive. That's one more heart separating yourself from life and death. You'll also have to choose specific perks tied to this path. These perks could allow you to pickup more health, poison your enemis, protect yourself or get reduction at your local merchant.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/5771f37034c5716ca67e1b85f0ddb7014bdf0c02.gif[/img]

notes.title: Level up - Soldier's path
notes.notes:
Exploding everything you can see will lead to the unfortunate disappearance of your foes. 

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/78bc01405a61632633957bc8c90d77f9e772a2a2.gif[/img]

But this will allow you to gain experience and to level up at some point. Leveling up is an important part of Bibots. Each time doing so you can upgrade Tayar's abilities according to 3 main paths: Soldier, Scientist or Survivalist. This will grant you a main bonus affecting your statistics and one choice between 3 perks that depends on your path choice. Today we'll focus on the Soldier's path as Tayar can be many things, one of them is being a soldier. 

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/cf8e89bd18b155f93889d2b07c61cf06f6fb2042.gif[/img]

When leveling up as a Soldier, Tayar obtains an attack bonus helping you defeat your foes quicker. But you also have to choose one perk between 3 choices. These perks can be game changer during your runs, pick meticulously, take perks that synergize with each others and make your way through Takaful's dangerous environment easier. Here are some examples of perks :

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/cbf8fd78173afcc719d2dcd2fa8e28524ca06e3f.gif[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1610500/Bibots/

notes.title: Psym, the vital energy
notes.notes:
It has been observed by a lot of different ways by the Crob people. First perceived as divine, then magical, it has finally been controled and used as fuel for crobs' technologies.     

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/9f43ef1de6ea185fb75116a03fffc7b2ea229eae.png[/img]

Psym is a an unstable matter which revealed to be dangerous as stabilisation attemps went on. Authorities established laws forbiding civilian experimenting with Psym.       

Those laws have long been respected... Until the Great Explorer drifted away.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1610500/Bibots/

notes.title: Discover the world of Bibots!
notes.notes:
Maghamir, evil mastermind, wasn’t always one. He was, before all these events, recognized as the Grand Adventurer and one of the first Crob to repel the territory’s limit.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/f1aae4a16b8f91d688d0b7bd06ab5f1945730c32.png[/img]

His adventures have worn him down both physically and mentally, pushing him to the point of no return. Experiencing the psym effect on himself brought out the darkest sides of his personality.

After many years of silence, his acolyte regained the capital to warn the great council that the Grand Adventurer Maghamir had lost his reason with the objective to raze Takaful and its inhabitants with the Bibot Arch. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1610500/Bibots/?l=french
